title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
abstract: arXiv:2607.28591v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling coding agents requires a continuing supply of executable data for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation. Each task must couple a realistic software state with a specification, development tools, and reliable verification. To expand this supply, we present Change2Task, a system grounded in repository history that converts merged pull requests (PRs) into verified tasks on healthy modern revisions of the same repository. It aligns historical evidence with evolved code, reconstructs task states through Patch Reversal, Code Mapping, or Agent Reconstruction, and validates the lifecycle from a healthy base to a task state and a restored state. By deriving multiple tasks grounded in developer evidence from maintained environments, Change2Task provides executable data for coding agent training and evaluation while reducing repeated environment setup, storage, and task construction effort. translated_title: Change2Task：从仓库变更到可执行的编码智能体任务与环境
translated_abstract: 扩展编码智能体需要持续供给可执行的数据，用于训练、基准测试和持续评估。每个任务必须将真实的软件状态与任务规范、开发工具和可靠的验证相结合。为了扩大这一供给，我们提出了 Change2Task，这是一个基于仓库历史的系统，它将已合并的拉取请求（PR）转换为同一仓库健康现代版本上经过验证的任务。它将历史证据与演进的代码进行对齐，通过补丁反转、代码映射或智能体重建三种方式重建任务状态，并验证从健康基础状态到任务状态再到恢复状态的完整生命周期。通过从维护良好的环境中推导出多个基于开发者证据的任务，Change2Task 为编码智能体的训练和评估提供了可执行数据，同时减少了重复的环境搭建、存储和任务构建成本。我们评估了五个编码智能体……（原文截断）
tldr: Change2Task 提出了一个基于仓库历史的系统，能够将已合并的拉取请求自动转换为健康现代代码版本上经过验证的可执行编码智能体任务与环境，为编码智能体的训练、基准测试和持续评估提供可扩展的数据供给。
en_tdlr: Change2Task is a repository-history-grounded system that converts merged pull requests into verified executable coding agent tasks and environments on healthy modern revisions, providing scalable data for training, benchmarking, and evaluating coding agents.
